meta.description: Fires when a human signs a CITINEL CERT-In draft. Fans the signed incident out to CISO comms, a compliance-drive export, and a follow-up ticket -- the post-signoff work the core pipeline deliberately does NOT do itself (we draft, we never file). n8n owns this VISIBLE escalation/export flow; OPA remains the sole policy authority. Best Use of n8n: the automation demonstrably improves the post-signoff UX by removing four manual handoffs. The ack this flow returns is computed from what actually happened on each branch, not assumed -- a branch that fails still lets the other two through and is reported by name, never silently folded into a false 'all succeeded'.

assignments.name: summary
assignments.value: ={{$json.incident_id}} ({{$json.severity}}) on {{$json.hosts}} was reviewed and signed by {{$json.signed_by}} at {{$json.signed_at}}. CERT-In draft attached; deadline {{$json.clock_deadline}}.

nodes.name: Notify CISO (Slack)
nodes.notes: Swap for Send Email if the bank uses email; either satisfies the criterion. Comms only -- never a policy decision.

nodes.name: Export to Compliance Drive
nodes.notes: Exports the signed draft to the bank's compliance archive. Export only -- CITINEL never machine-files to CERT-In (no API exists).

nodes.name: Create Follow-up Ticket
nodes.notes: Opens the recurrence-prevention / RCA follow-up ticket the DPDP report references.

nodes.name: Merge Branch Results
nodes.notes: Waits for all three branches (success or handled failure) before anything is acknowledged. Append mode: outputs each branch's result as a separate item, in input-slot order (0=Slack, 1=Drive, 2=Jira) -- Compute Delivery Status relies on that ordering.

nodes.name: Compute Delivery Status
nodes.notes: The honesty seam: turns three branch outcomes into the channels/failed_channels lists the ack actually reports, instead of a hardcoded 'all three succeeded'.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: $json.failed_channels.length ? "partially_escalated" : "escalated", incident_id: $('Format Notification').item.json.incident_id, channels: $json.channels, failed_channels: $json.failed_channels }) }}
